title: Risk Assurance Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Madrid, Spain  |💰 €53,000 - €65,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> </p> <h3><strong>⭐Our Risk and Compliance team</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Bank Europe (MBEU) is the Irish-based subsidiary of the Monzo Group and the strategic launchpad for our expansion across the European Union. We are looking for a seasoned Risk Assurance Manager to provide independent Second-Line of Defence (2LOD) assurance over the design and effectiveness of the bank’s risk management framework, controls and processes. You will ensure that key risks are managed in line with regulatory expectations, internal policies and our risk appetite, providing robust oversight and challenge across the full spectrum of the bank’s risk universe.</p> <p>In this role, you will ensure the bank complies with:</p> <ul> <li>Irish Regulatory Obligations, including CBI, CPC, AML/CFT legislation, and the Companies Act.</li> <li>EU Regulatory Requirements, including DORA, EBA Guidelines, ECB/SSM expectations, and GDPR.</li> <li>Internal Governance, including adherence to risk frameworks, policies, and risk appetite.</li> </ul> <p>Reporting directly to the Director of Risk Assurance, MBEU, you will design, execute, and report on 2LOD assurance reviews covering conduct, financial crime, fraud, credit, and financial risks. Your remit will also include operational risk, ICT and information security, outsourcing, data protection and governance structures. This role is critical in fostering a sound risk culture and supporting senior management and the Board in their oversight responsibilities.You will be instrumental in providing stakeholders with the assurance needed to ensure our growth is safe, resilient and compliant.</p> <p>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function (CF-2) within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards 2018 issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <h3>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h3> <ul> <li>Assurance Plan: Planning, coordinating and executing comprehensive risk assurance activities, including effectiveness reviews to ensure EU-wide adherence to the enterprise risk framework.</li> <li>Thematic Reviews: Conducting targeted thematic reviews across specific risk areas (e.g., conduct, compliance, financial crime, IT, prudential and strategic risk) to provide in-depth assurance over design adequacy and operating effectiveness.</li> <li>Remediation: Identifying areas for improvement within the risk management framework and control environment, recommending practical, impactful solutions and tracking remediation efforts to completion.</li> <li>Stakeholder Engagement: Proactively engage with business and risk stakeholders to understand Monzo Europe’s products and risk profiles, fostering a collaborative and transparent risk culture.</li> <li>Strategic Planning: Contributing to the annual risk assurance plan by providing insights gathered through continuous monitoring of regulatory trends and horizon scanning, market practices and upstream developments.</li> <li>Framework Governance: Contribute to the continuous improvement of the 2LOD Risk Assurance Framework, Methodology and Terms of Reference to ensure they remain fit-for-purpose and market-leading.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering closely with First-Line of Defence (1LOD) control testing, Group 2LOD, and Internal Audit to ensure alignment while maintaining strict independent challenge.</li> <li>Reporting & Governance: Contributing to risk governance by reporting thematic insights, trends and remediation progress to senior management committees.</li> <li>Risk Culture: Promote a strong risk and compliance culture, awareness and training programs across the organisation.</li> </ul> <h3>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h3> <ul> <li>You have a strong background in risk assurance, internal audit and/or risk management within banking or fintech in the European regulatory and financial services landscape. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to plan and execute diverse assurance activities, from effectiveness reviews to thematic deep dives, with a clear focus on root cause analysis.</li> <li>You’ve led reviews across a wide range of risk areas, including ICT and Information Security, Financial/Prudential (Liquidity, Treasury, Capital), Fraud and Financial Crime (AML/Sanctions), Operational and Conduct Risk (Consumer Protection/Vulnerability).</li> <li>You possess a deep understanding of risk and control frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO) and can practically apply this knowledge to 2LOD oversight.</li> <li>You are skilled in the hands-on identification and testing of risks and controls, with a keen eye for detail and potential weaknesses.</li> <li>You have a track record of identifying gaps within risk management processes and frameworks and recommending practical, high-impact solutions.</li> <li>You combine sharp analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders, offering constructive challenge and influencing at all levels.</li> <li>You have strong data analysis skills, you know how to extract, interrogate and present data in a way that makes complex issues easy for stakeholders to understand.</li> <li>You’re proficient in Google Suite and can build high-quality decks for Committee and Board reporting. Experience with SQL or Python is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h3>🙌What’s in it for you</h3> <p>💰A base salary range of €53,000 - €65,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Madrid office 2 - 3 days a week, however, you will be expected to travel to Monzo’s head offices in Dublin and/or London from time to time.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 38 days including public holidays</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <h3>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</h3> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of our hiring team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with a member of our Executive team</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. left;">Serving as the primary driver and coordinator for the Model Risk Oversight Committee (MROC), ensuring material risk metrics, model validations and escalations are effectively reported to the Executive Risk Committee (ERC) and the Board Risk Committee (BRC).</li> <li style="text-align: left;">Establishing and maintaining a centralised suite of model validation standards including those used for performance monitoring.</li> <li style="text-align: left;">Maintaining MBEU Model Inventory including AI Use Case registries, ensuring appropriate tiering classification of material and high-risk models in alignment with the EU AI Act.</li> <li style="text-align: left;">Managing the local embedding of the group-wide model risk governance frameworks, ensuring appropriate alignment and clear escalation protocols between global frameworks and subsidiary-specific policy standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Independent Model Validation & Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading the technical 2LOD validation of all material and high-risk models prior to deployment, evaluating mathematical logic, data lineage, conceptual soundness, stability, performance and potential algorithmic bias. </li> <li>Providing 2LOD independent oversight and technical validation across key risk domains including:</li> <ul> <li><strong>Credit Risk</strong> covering credit scoring, automated underwriting decision engines, customer affordability and IFRS 9 loan loss provisioning models.</li> <li><strong>Fraud & Financial Crime</strong> <strong>Risk</strong> covering digital onboarding risk assessment scorecards and real-time fraud/transaction monitoring models.</li> <li><strong>Financial Risk</strong> covering financial planning models, ICAAP/ILAAP stress testing, Pillar 2 economic capital models, macroeconomic forecasting, Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) models.</li> </ul> <li>Establishing ongoing monitoring standards, including back-testing, benchmarking, and sensitivity analysis, to detect model drift or performance degradation.</li> <li>Issuing formal 2LOD Opinions on model changes, and track validation findings and action closures for regular reporting to the Model Risk Oversight Committee (MROC).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Advanced Modelling Technologies and AI Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Developing and operationalising independent 2LoD validation protocols for advanced Machine Learning (ML) methodologies and automated decisioning systems running on production platforms.</li> <li>Establishing targeted risk oversight frameworks and registration protocols for Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) use cases deployed across bank operations.</li> <li>Directing technical validation activities to meet compliance with evolving European AI Act legislation and Monzo's internal Artificial Intelligence Standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Regulatory Compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Reviewing all methodologies, modelling techniques and validation approaches to ensure continuous alignment with local and European regulatory expectations.</li> <li>Leading the 2LOD assessment of evolving regulatory requirements with a specific focus on ECB and EBA Guidelines (eg, Loan Origination and Monitoring), IFRS 9 accounting standards, GDPR data privacy mandates and European consumer credit directives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Committee Governance and Independent Challenge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serving as the Secretariat function for the MBEU Model Risk Oversight Committee shaping technical agendas, tracking validation actions, and presenting validation reports and 2LOD opinions.</li> <li>Managing formal reporting lines and ensuring the immediate escalation of material Model Risk Appetite breaches or validation failures to the Executive Risk Committee (ERC) and Board Risk Committee (BRC).</li> <li>Providing clear, objective and evidence-based technical challenge to first-line (1LOD) model developers, model owners and accountable executive stakeholders throughout the validation lifecycle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership and Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establishing and scaling the 2LOD model risk oversight function, managing resourcing and budget and customising risk governance processes for a newly authorised entity.</li> <li>Optimising the 2LOD validation workflow through the evaluation and adoption of developer productivity utilities and generative or agentic AI co-working tools.</li> <li>Acting as the principal point of contact for external regulators (e.g., Central Bank of Ireland), internal audit and external reviewers regarding model risk profile and validation backlogs.</li> <li>Challenging 1LOD quantitative development teams constructively, balancing business velocity and commercial goals with rigorous risk boundaries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a post-graduate degree (MSc or PhD) in a highly quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Data Science or Physics.</li> <li>You bring extensive experience in quantitative Model Risk Management within a tier-1 bank, rapid-growth challenger bank, or premier financial regulatory consulting practice.</li> <li>You possess advanced quantitative knowledge across retail credit risk scoring (PD, LGD, EAD), IFRS9 impairment modelling, Economic Capital, ICAAP and ILAAP, macroeconomic stress testing, and fraud/financial crime modelling techniques.</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of European prudential regulations, ECB internal model guidelines, ECB Guide to ICAAP and ILAAP, EBA standards, Consumer Credit Directive (CCD2), GDPR data privacy mandates, and the European AI Act.</li> <li>You are highly tech-fluent, featuring hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python, with an eagerness to deploy generative or agentic AI tools to optimise risk workflows.</li> <li>You demonstrate the capability to deliver clear, structured, and objective technical challenge to first-line analytics, data science, and engineering squads.</li> <li>You possess a strong track record in designing, scaling, or managing comprehensive model risk governance frameworks from scratch under data-sparse conditions.</li> <li>You are capable of translating complex econometric, statistical and machine learning concepts into clear, actionable, risk-oriented insights for the senior management and the board.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €102,000 - €138,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍 This role can be based in our Barcelona, or Madrid office and expected travel to Monzo’s head offices in Dublin and/or London from time to time.</p> <p>⏰ We learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to Spain</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory
